name: KPI Diagnostic
summary: A number turned red. Ten statements show whether the cause is clarity, skill, capacity, process design or ownership, with first moves for each.

name: 5 Whys
summary: Move from a symptom to a root cause you can change, then agree one countermeasure, one owner and one check. Print it or save it as PDF.

name: Damage Control
summary: Log damaged units by stage and cause. See the damage rate, DPMO and sigma level, the few causes behind most of it, and where to start.

name: Incomplete Control
summary: Log orders that left without every item or parcel. See the incomplete rate, DPMO and sigma level, the causes behind most misses, and where they start.

name: Delay Analyzer
summary: Log planned and actual route times. See the on-time rate, how much delay starts at the dock and how much on the road, and the reasons and hours behind it.

name: Night Audit Log
summary: Log the no-shows, declined cards, posting errors and open balances the night audit finds. See the exception rate, DPMO and sigma level, the causes behind most of them, and where in the stay they start.

name: Sigma & Control Chart
summary: Turn defects into a sigma level, combine on time, undamaged and complete into perfect delivery, and see whether a bad day is a signal or noise.

name: Pareto 80/20
summary: Which few causes make most of your delays, errors, idle time or complaints? Templates for delivery, warehouse and hotel, CSV and Excel import, a checked chart.

name: Last-Mile CX Control Tower
summary: Perfect Delivery per order, on time, incomplete, damage, cold chain, loading and departures, partner and driver scorecards, route risk, root-cause Pareto, actions and a weekly review. A deep dive on one failure: where it concentrates, the evidence rows and an investigation that becomes a verified action. Reads your Excel workbook.

name: Six Sigma in the Warehouse
summary: DMAIC in five steps on one warehouse case, with the tool to use at each step, three questions per step, the eight wastes and a project charter.

name: Shift Handover
summary: Numbers, open issues with an owner and a time, heads-up and safety in one handover. Open issues carry over to the next shift by themselves.

name: Shift Pulse
summary: Damage, incomplete orders, late routes, safety, OEE, open actions and the handover in one picture, by day or week. Trend charts, flags for what is off, and a summary to copy or print.

name: CV Builder
summary: A designer-quality CV on live A4 pages: photo, key figures, and company logos found from a website. In English, German or Albanian, saved as PDF.

name: ATS CV
summary: Drop in the CV you have, as PDF or Word. Get a clean one-column version that application software reads, matched to the job ad, as PDF, Word or text.

name: Cover Letter
summary: The letter in the same design as your CV, with your details taken from it and a first draft from a few answers. PDF or Word.

name: Action Tracker
summary: One list for every countermeasure, finding and signal from the other tools: owner, due date, status and how it is verified. Overdue first, a weekly review in ten minutes, calendar and Excel export.

name: Daily Board
summary: Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and People as five month calendars of green, amber and red days, filled from your logs. Open actions, carried handover issues and a ten-minute huddle agenda to read out or print.

name: 5S Audit
summary: Walk one area and score each S from 0 to 4, in 5S, 6S or 8S, with checklists for warehouse, hotel and delivery station. A radar against the last walk, the trend and a league table by area, findings straight into actions and a red tag register.

name: Safety Cross
summary: Every accident, near miss and unsafe condition on the green cross of the month, with days since the last accident, LTIFR, TRIR and the Bird pyramid. The cause to tackle first, open actions and a talk for today's briefing.

name: A3 Report
summary: One problem on one sheet, the Toyota way: the facts and the number, the target and its date, the root cause, countermeasures with an owner each, and the follow-up. An eight-point check, print on A3 or A4, Word.

name: Kaizen Board
summary: Every improvement idea of the team on one board, from Idea through Plan, Do and Check to Adopted, with an effort and impact matrix that shows the quick wins. Adoption rate, days to adopted, savings per month and year, and the idea of the month.

name: Skills Matrix
summary: Rate each person on each task from 0 to 4 in an ILU grid, with templates for warehouse, hotel front office and delivery station. Cover against target, single points of failure, cover per shift and a training plan that pairs a level 4 with a trainee, straight into actions.

name: OEE
summary: Log each shift of a machine with its stops, pieces and rejects. Availability, performance, quality and OEE, the six big losses day by day, and the one to attack first.

name: Hotel KPIs
summary: Each night's rooms sold, revenue, no-shows, rooms out of order and complaints, pasted from the PMS. Occupancy, ADR and RevPAR against budget, the month's forecast, the weekday pattern, the revenue that leaked and a morning report to copy.

name: Fishbone
summary: Put the effect at the head and collect causes with the team on the 6M, 4P or hotel bones, each with its why. Votes and likely causes rank them, the likely ones become actions to verify, and the top one goes to 5 Whys or the causes to Pareto.

name: FMEA
summary: Write down how each process step can fail, rate severity, occurrence and detection, and get the RPN and the AIAG-VDA action priority. A heat map, the top ten risks and the actions with owners until the re-rating shows the risk is gone.

name: Process Lab
summary: Paste measurements and get the right control chart (I-MR, Xbar-R/S, np, c, u) with Nelson rules and before/after phases, Cpk, chi-square, regression and a Gage R&R or attribute agreement study. Every number in plain words.

name: Time Study
summary: Time each element over five cycles with a stopwatch, space bar as the lap key. Get the standard time per station, takt from demand, a Yamazumi against it and the first element to move.

name: Value Stream Map
summary: Map one flow from supplier to customer with the pieces waiting between the steps. Get the lead-time ladder, PCE, takt and the bottleneck, then draw the future state and send its kaizen bursts to the Action Tracker.

name: Standard Work
summary: One job as a TWI breakdown: major steps, key points marked Safety, Quality, Technique or Cost, and a reason for each, with the time per step against the takt. Versions with change notes, print on A4, Word.

name: Gemba Walk
summary: Layered process audits by team lead, area manager and site lead, with yes or no checks on the standard for warehouse, hotel and delivery station, and a waste walk that counts the 8 wastes, Mura and Muri. Compliance per week and layer, where the no answers sit, which layer is late, and findings straight into actions.

name: Operations Report
summary: The weekly or monthly report for your manager, written from the data of the other tools: safety, quality, delivery, OEE, 5S, hotel, Kaizen and actions, each against the period before and its target. What got better, what got worse, the biggest risk, one decision and three priorities. Text, A4 or Word.

name: Spaghetti Diagram
summary: Draw the walking paths of one job over the floor plan, tap by tap, in metres. Get the metres and minutes walked per shift, the stop visited most and the longest repeated leg, then compare the layout after the change.
